# Third-party notices

The generated design-recipe catalog distributed with `plaindeck` contains
design metadata derived from
[Mappedinfo/juya-news-card](https://github.com/Mappedinfo/juya-news-card).
The recipes are native PlainDeck reconstructions rather than copies of the
original React components.
